name: Pocket
author: jrmmhm
description: Tuck a run of bar widgets into one slot and fan them back out on hover. Drag a widget onto it to put it away, drag it back past it to get it out. The widgets never leave the bar layout, so every Omarchy tool keeps reporting them correctly.

barWidget.description: Hides the bar widgets you drag onto it and shows them again while the pointer is on them

schema.label: Widget ids to tuck away, comma separated
schema.description: Usually set by dragging widgets onto the pocket. Edit it here to name them by hand.
